rows.grounds: instrumental of compound paryanta-avaṭaka; refers to the final divisor/remainder group in the calculation
particle introducing an alternative or subsequent step
object to be determined in the calculation
optative expressing prescribed action; root kl̥p with sam

items.question: By what final remainder-division should a wise person determine the weekday?
premises: Previous steps divide the remainder by specified numerical divisors.
The final avaṭaka provides an alternative basis for calculation.
A wise person is enjoined to determine the weekday accordingly.
items.inference: Therefore, the wise person should determine the weekday by means of the final avaṭaka.
uncertainties: The exact numerical value or identity of paryantāvaṭaka in this procedural context is not fully specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Or else, by the final avaṭaka, the wise one should determine the weekday.
